## Peer-reviewed publications

- Gomez, R., Hein, K., Conkey-Morrison, C., Stavropoulos, V., & Zarate, D. (2026). The CBCL DSM-oriented somatic problems scale. *BMC Psychology*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1186/s40359-026-05842-2)
- Brown, T., Hunt, B., Conkey-Morrison, C., Burleigh, T. L., Stavropoulos, V., & Lubman, D. (2026). *Beyond screen time*. *Australian Journal of General Practice*. Accepted.
- Zarate, D., Jarrad, J., Stavropoulos, V., Conkey-Morrison, C., & Hunt, B. (2026). Mental health, personality, and cross-addictions as predictors of social media addiction. *Addictive Behaviors Reports*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.abrep.2026.100718)
- Gomez, R., Hunt, B., & Conkey-Morrison, C. (2025). Incremental validity of cognitive and sensation-seeking traits in ADHD symptoms. *Journal of Psychopathology and Behavioral Assessment*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10862-025-10252-6)
- Conkey-Morrison, C., Zarate, D., March, E., Hunt, B., & Stavropoulos, V. (2025). Stress-coping mechanisms and problematic social media use. *Computers in Human Behavior Reports*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chbr.2025.100848)
- *Flowing in the net of disordered gaming: A network analysis approach*. (2025). *Addictive Behaviors Reports*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.abrep.2025.100606)
- *Examining how gamers connect with their avatars to assess their anxiety*. (2024). *Acta Psychologica*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.actpsy.2024.104298)

Manuscripts under review and in preparation are not listed on this public CV.
